run_inference_on_single_image: run object detection inference on a single image using a Detectron model config and weights file
run_inference_on_image_folder: run object detection inference on all images with a specific extension in a folder and save visualizations
run_inference_with_custom_threshold: run inference with a custom detection threshold and keypoint threshold for visualization output
run_inference_with_always_output: run inference that outputs visualization images even when no objects are detected in the input image
run_inference_with_custom_output_format: run inference and save detection visualizations in a custom output format like pdf or png
